{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    localparam LEVELS = (WIDTH > 1) ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 0;
    wire negate_a = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire negate_b = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire carry_in = negate_a | negate_b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] x = a ^ {WIDTH{negate_a}};
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] y = b ^ {WIDTH{negate_b}};
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bit_propagate = x ^ y;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] prefix_p [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] prefix_g [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] arithmetic_result;

    assign prefix_p[0] = bit_propagate;
    assign prefix_g[0][0] = (x[0] & y[0]) |
                                      (bit_propagate[0] & carry_in);
    genvar bit_index, level, column;
    generate
        for (bit_index = 1; bit_index < WIDTH; bit_index = bit_index + 1) begin: initial_generate
            assign prefix_g[0][bit_index] = x[bit_index] & y[bit_index];
        end
        for (level = 0; level < LEVELS; level = level + 1) begin: prefix_level
            for (column = 0; column < WIDTH; column = column + 1) begin: prefix_column
                if (column >= (1 << level)) begin: combine
                    assign prefix_g[level+1][column] =
                        prefix_g[level][column] |
                        (prefix_p[level][column] &
                         prefix_g[level][column-(1 << level)]);
                    assign prefix_p[level+1][column] =
                        prefix_p[level][column] &
                        prefix_p[level][column-(1 << level)];
                end else begin: pass_through
                    assign prefix_g[level+1][column] = prefix_g[level][column];
                    assign prefix_p[level+1][column] = prefix_p[level][column];
                end
            end
        end
        for (bit_index = 0; bit_index < WIDTH; bit_index = bit_index + 1) begin: result_bits
            if (bit_index == 0) begin: low_bit
                assign arithmetic_result[bit_index] = bit_propagate[bit_index] ^ carry_in;
            end else begin: upper_bit
                assign arithmetic_result[bit_index] =
                    bit_propagate[bit_index] ^ prefix_g[LEVELS][bit_index-1];
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    always @* begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b001: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b010: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;
            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;
            default: sum = {WIDTH{1'b0}};
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module pw_pipeline_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter STAGES = 2
)(
    input wire clk, rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] result,
    output wire out_valid
);
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg input_valid;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] alu_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] stage_data [0:STAGES-2];
    wire stage_valid [0:STAGES-2];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            operand_a <= 0;
            operand_b <= 0;
            opcode <= 0;
            input_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            operand_a <= a;
            operand_b <= b;
            opcode <= Oper;
            input_valid <= in_valid;
        end
    end

    pw_alu #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) alu (
        .a(operand_a), .b(operand_b), .Oper(opcode), .sum(alu_result)
    );

    genvar index;
    generate
        for (index = 0; index < STAGES-1; index = index+1) begin: output_pipeline
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_reg;
            reg valid_reg;
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] next_data;
            wire next_valid;
            if (index == 0) begin: first_stage
                assign next_data = alu_result;
                assign next_valid = input_valid;
            end else begin: following_stage
                assign next_data = stage_data[index-1];
                assign next_valid = stage_valid[index-1];
            end
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin
                    data_reg <= 0;
                    valid_reg <= 0;
                end else begin
                    data_reg <= next_data;
                    valid_reg <= next_valid;
                end
            end
            assign stage_data[index] = data_reg;
            assign stage_valid[index] = valid_reg;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign result = stage_data[STAGES-2];
    assign out_valid = stage_valid[STAGES-2];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The likely critical cone is opcode/operand register Q through arithmetic selection, carry computation and result selection to the first output register. The supplied mapped paths show substantial control buffering and multiple carry-like logic levels, although their exact source attribution is unavailable.",
  "rewrite": "Replace the three arithmetic expressions with one shared, explicit parallel-prefix adder. Opcode 001 complements b; opcode 010 complements a; either subtraction supplies carry-in one. The carry-in is absorbed into bit-zero generation, avoiding a separate carry-in selection level after the prefix network. At WIDTH=32, carry generation uses five prefix levels. All pipeline registers, names, reset assignments and valid propagation remain unchanged.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "A plausible target is a few tenths of a nanosecond improvement over the 7.17 ns baseline WNS through shallower carry computation and shared arithmetic. This is an estimate, not a measured result; fixed-flow synthesis and STA must establish the actual gain.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The prefix network uses more wiring and intermediate carry logic than a compact ripple adder, but shares one arithmetic datapath across all three arithmetic operations. Register count is unchanged. Mapping can remove unused prefix terms. Compliance with the 10341.668480 um2 area cap and electrical limits requires evaluation; no measured candidate results are available.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Unsigned WIDTH-bit modulo arithmetic preserves addition, a-b and b-a, including truncation. Bitwise operations and opcode 111 zero default are unchanged. No retiming, additional state, initialization, clock changes or reset changes are introduced. Original named state and output_pipeline hierarchy are retained. Data is computed even when valid is low, and repeated synchronous resets retain their original priority. The implementation supports positive WIDTH values and the original STAGES=2 or STAGES=3 configurations without additional startup or input assumptions."
}
